thesis.headline: Can synthetic heartbeats help detect atrial fibrillation?

strip.normalNote: Even beats, each with a P wave before the spike.
strip.afNote: Uneven beats, no P wave, a restless baseline.
strip.disclaimer: Illustrative trace drawn by this app. Not patient data.

steps.title: Wavelet domain
steps.detail: The ECG is moved into an invertible wavelet domain, so whatever is generated there converts back to a signal.

steps.title: WGAN-GP
steps.detail: A WGAN-GP learns to generate synthetic ECG in that domain.

steps.title: EfficientNet-B0
steps.detail: A transfer-learning classifier for atrial fibrillation, on the MIT-BIH AF Database.

thesis.finding: The synthetic data gave no detectable gain. The classifier works; the generated heartbeats did not make it better. That is the result.

projects.course: Circuitos Microelectrónicos II · Final project · April 2026
projects.title: An ultrasonic obstacle detector, stage by stage
projects.summary: A 40 kHz pulse-echo chain: send a burst, catch the echo, make it readable.

facts.title: Burst
facts.detail: NE555 and NE556 timers, a NOR gate and a CMOS driver generate the 40 kHz burst.

facts.title: Amplify and filter
facts.detail: A non-inverting amplifier and a Sallen-Key band-pass: Q≈2, gain 20–50, on a TL084.

facts.title: Detect
facts.detail: A precision full-wave rectifier and a second-order active low-pass follow the envelope.

captions: The transmitter sends a short 40 kHz burst.
The echo comes back at about 30 mV, close to the noise.
Amplified and band-passed: about 10 V peak to peak.
Rectified and low-pass filtered: the envelope of the echo.
bench.note: Illustrative traces drawn by this app. Not measurements.

projects.course: Biomedical Signal Processing · 4th year · Taught in English
projects.title: Cleaning real ECG, EMG and EEG
projects.summary: Three MATLAB practicals on real recordings: find the noise, pick the filter, keep the signal.

facts.title: ECG
facts.detail: PTB Diagnostic database. FFT spectra, R-peak detection, a healthy patient compared with a cardiac patient.

facts.title: EMG
facts.detail: Motion below 20 Hz, 50 Hz mains, artefacts above 150 Hz. Rectification and envelope.

facts.title: EEG
facts.detail: Eye, muscle, electrode and mains artefacts. Butterworth, Chebyshev and elliptic filters compared.

bench.idle: Raw signal: drift, hum and noise. Switch the ECG filters on.

desk.headline: Desk: a life desk run by nightly agents.
desk.summary: Cloud agents read the inbox and the calendar every night and write a brief into a private git vault. Desk is the native Mac app that reads it: what is due, what needs a reply, what to confirm. It holds no credentials, renders untrusted text as plain text, and changes nothing without a click.

desk.architectureNote: One writer per file · no server · no tokens in the app
